notes.content: W3-4 DONE (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). Sign all releases: minisign (tools/signer Go CLI over jedisct1/go-minisign — keygen/sign/verify, C-reference key formats, interop-tested) for the 5 agent binaries + install.sh/ps1 + SHA256SUMS; cosign keyless (Sigstore OIDC) for GHCR server image on main pushes AND release tags. Release v0.4.0 = 17 assets, each artifact + .minisig + minisign.pub; external skeptic pass: sha256sum -c 7/7, minisign verify 8/8. Key id 019BF5A0CA5040DD (keys/minisign.pub committed; secret in MINISIGN_PRIVKEY/MINISIGN_PASS GH secrets; local pass /tmp/rmmway-minisign-pass). Makefile: make sign / verify-sigs / signer-test. Both workflows have cosign verify self-checks (use --certificate-identity-regexp, NOT --certificate-identity which is exact-match; issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com). Final commits: 5d820a4 (claim) → 6ca926f (impl) → 2e312f3/dc978e3/e4fc4fb (env-specific fixes) → 7a704db (board done). CI GO_VERSION now 1.27 (go1.24.5 runner gofmt flagged server/cmd/e2e/caps/main.go pre-existing — quirk of this env). Env quirks: raw github release-asset download URLs 404 but `gh release download` works; batch `gh release upload` hits transient 422 name-exists (per-file + --clobber + retry in workflow); gh api run .jobs is null, server-job logs only via web job page annotations.

W4-1 DONE (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). CycloneDX SBOM per artifact: release v0.5.0 = 29 assets — every artifact ships <artifact>.cdx.json (CycloneDX 1.7 JSON, pinned syft 1.51.0 via scripts/install-syft.sh, sha256-verified; scripts/sbom.sh; make sbom / sbom-agent / image). Agent SBOMs = 13 Go modules + binary sha256 in metadata.component.version; server image SBOM = 23 Go modules + 5 distroless deb OS packages (base-files, ca-certificates, media-types, netbase, tzdata) + debian 12.15 OS component + ~950 files (282KB). Image SBOM in CI: buildx outputs: type=docker,dest=server-image.tar (works WITH push:true) → syft docker-archive: (no registry auth needed). Server image SBOM: cosign attach sbom --type cyclonedx to GHCR digest (cosign 3.x: command is `attach sbom` subcommand, NOT attach-sbom; deprecated but present in 3.0.6 = cosign-installer@v3 default; media type application/vnd.cyclonedx+json). All 6 SBOMs minisigned (sign.sh now 13-artifact set incl. 5 agent SBOMs + SHA256SUMS extended; server SBOM signed in release.yml server job which needed setup-go added). release.yml: new `release` job creates the GitHub release BEFORE agent/server jobs (they run in parallel; first v0.5.0 cut failed: server job "release not found" race — fix 2513256). syft version output: use awk '/^Version:/' (GoVersion/SchemaVersion also match). Local: docker.io installed + dockerd runs (no buildx plugin); gh token lacks read/write:packages so GHCR pull/push from local fails 403 (CI GITHUB_TOKEN fine). External skeptic pass v0.5.0: 29 assets, sha256sum -c 12/12, signer verify 14/14 incl all 6 SBOMs, SBOM sha matches binary. Commits: 4bc9b05 (claim) → fed58d3 (impl) → 2513256 (release-job race fix) → e68dc05 (board). GH runs: CI 32800383098 + Release 32800419608 green.

W4-2 COMPLETE + pushed (main). Agent verifies the release signature before auto-updating. Trust anchor = minisign public key pinned in-binary (agent/internal/update/minisign.pub, W3-4 key 019BF5A0CA5040DD; RMMWAY_UPDATE_PUBKEY overrides). Agent Updater (verify-only go-minisign 2023): manifest -> platform asset -> version gate (no downgrades) -> publisher-key gate (manifest.public_key must equal pinned) -> download bin+.minisig -> sha256 -> minisign -> atomic install (in-use .exe staged .pending) -> reexec. `rmmway-agent update [--check/--no-restart/--server]`; background auto-update in run (RMMWAY_AUTO_UPDATE, RMMWAY_UPDATE_INTERVAL, default 15m, on by default); ApplyPending at boot. Server: internal/releases serves GET /agent/releases/latest + /latest/<asset> (open, agent-facing) from RMMWAY_RELEASES_DIR, allowlisted from release.json (traversal-safe), manifest re-read per request (no restart on publish). cmd/publish-release assembles a release dir from agent/dist (requires each signed). Files: agent/internal/update/{pinned,verify,manifest,update,install,reexec_unix,reexec_windows,io}.go + _test + minisign.pub + testdata; server/internal/releases/{release,_test}.go; server/cmd/e2e/update/{main,serve}.go; server/cmd/publish-release/main.go. Commits: eaa6365 (impl), a9515a0 (board), e4a98a4 (ci yaml-quote fix). Rebased over W5-1 (self-healing heal pkg) which merged cleanly (conflicts only in httpapi.go/main.go/TASKS.md — both keep both Heal+Releases). All tests+e2e green; CI has `cd server && go run ./cmd/e2e/update`. Board now 21/28. NOTE: local heal e2e needs a CREATEDB role (default rmmway lacks it; use RMMWAY_PG_DSN=postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres).

W4-3 IN PROGRESS (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). Per-client full export (no-lock-in): GET /api/devices/{id}/export (+ /admin mirror) streams a self-describing zip bundle: manifest.json (format rmmway-client-bundle v1, per-file sha256+size+rows), device.json (inventory+config from devices table), metrics.parquet (raw samples, optional since/until), metrics_1m.parquet (rollups, full history), alerts.json, README.md (duckdb/pandas open instructions). New pkg server/internal/export (Build + Verify: Verify re-hashes files, reads parquet back via parquet-go, checks row counts — the re-open/re-import proof). parquet-go dep: github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go v0.32.0 (pure Go). Postgres readers stream rows (pgx pool.Query is lazy). httpapi deviceSub gains {id}/export. e2e cmd/e2e/export: scratch Timescale DB, in-process httpapi, export+verify+range query+parquet re-read+re-import into fresh DB. CI: add timescale service (POSTGRES_USER=postgres so superuser/CREATEDB) + RMMWAY_TEST_PG_DSN (enables gated PG tests) + export e2e step. Local: Timescale at localhost:5432 (db rmmway, user rmmway NOT superuser; use postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres for e2e scratch-DB creation). go at /usr/local/go/bin (not on default PATH).
